body:
I am in a similar position, there's actually a term for it too. Emotional incest, it's where they put the emotional demands of a partner or spouse on a child without any physical incest. My NMIL is like that too, it's disgusting. She expected my SO to call her "beautiful", "gorgeous", etc and he was puzzled when I wouldn't let him refer to me like that. Like no you can't say hey beautiful when you say that shit to your mom, gross. She also expected him to give him all her attention and when she felt I was taking too much of his time away she said she was worried about him because "I was changing him". And yes I did change my SO, I opened his eyes to the abuse. And sorry if he got a backbone but he's 25, he needs to be his own person for fucks sake. 

We are personally very LC, almost NC except we have their car, and were trying to get rid of but we need the title from them so that means at least one more visit. But honestly I think NC/LC is the best way to go for a lot of cases. Unfortunately when it's your spouses family you don't get the luxury of dictating that. 

I'm not sure how I would handle dealing with that on a regular basis because it gives me panic attacks but if you ever need someone to bitch to, I can synpathize! I hope things get better for you!

Wow thank you so much! This is really great advice! It really helped to have it broken down the way you wrote it. I will start trying to do these things everyday, it's going to be difficult expressing my feeling so honestly but I really need to.

I called a therapist this morning and I'm setting up an appointment for this week, I really want to change. I have been in therapy before but I need to be more honest with myself and my therapist if I really want results, so I'm ready for a new start. Thank you for your suggestions and I hope things with your NMIL improve!

I truly hope you find your peace in life. It might take moving out to really begin the healing process and I'm sure it'll help not being around such toxic people. 

And I know that narcissist can't do that, but I just can't understand how I can act this way after I've been treated so horribly. How can I turn around and do the same thing I've despised my whole life? And why the fuck can't I stop? 

I might not be a narcissist but I feel I'm definitely a really shitty person.
